rules.name: whole_requirement_authority
rules.requirement: The requested product, use, dimensions, materials, applicable jurisdiction and drawing stage shall be explicit and traceable to authoritative inputs.
rules.failureCause: Geometry was generated before the intended product and authority hierarchy were locked.
rules.prevention: Block production status until wholeIntent, dimensionalAuthority and jurisdictionAndCodeEdition all pass.

rules.name: constraint_and_detail_proof
rules.requirement: Origin protocol, constraint compilation, whole-intent checks, detail proof and domain QA shall all pass independently.
rules.failureCause: A valid outline was treated as proof that every functional detail was correct.
rules.prevention: Require each named geometry gate; do not average or score away one failed detail.

rules.name: stage_appropriate_drafting
rules.requirement: Drawing layers, linetypes, lineweights, dimensions, annotation matrix, axes and axis identifiers shall satisfy the selected discipline and stage.
rules.failureCause: Coordinate validity was confused with readable professional drafting.
rules.prevention: Resolve a stage profile before drawing and reject every missing required annotation or semantic style class.

rules.name: recognisable_detail_geometry
rules.requirement: Required product details and furnishings shall be represented by typed, selectable geometry with a component matrix; labels and occupancy rectangles are not substitutes.
rules.failureCause: Object names and filled rectangles visually suggested details that were absent from CAD geometry.
rules.prevention: For every required object type, prove its minimum linework components, scale and clearance before delivery.

rules.name: sheet_revision_and_navigation_control
rules.requirement: Production candidates shall include populated paper-space sheets, title blocks, sheet numbers, plot scales, revisions, statuses, schedules and section/elevation/detail references where required.
rules.failureCause: A complete model-space drawing was exposed as a deliverable even though its paper-space and revision system were empty.
rules.prevention: Treat model geometry and published sheets as separate mandatory gates and validate their bindings.

rules.name: discipline_authority
rules.requirement: Site survey, geotechnical, structural, MEP, fire, accessibility, manufacturing or equivalent discipline evidence required by the project shall be present and current.
rules.failureCause: The CAD generator inferred engineering facts from an image or concept model.
rules.prevention: Image pixels never satisfy engineering authority; require hashed project evidence for every selected discipline gate.

rules.name: native_host_persistence
rules.requirement: When native deliverables are requested, the target host shall save, reopen and verify layers, coordinates, text, semantic metadata and hashes.
rules.failureCause: Portable output was assumed to prove native host persistence.
rules.prevention: Require a real host round trip and record exact host/version evidence before native artifacts are exposed.

rules.name: authorized_release
rules.requirement: A v3 evidence-contract pass shall retain reviewOnly=true and accepted=false and shall not claim technical-package readiness, production candidacy, manufacturing/fabrication readiness or authorization; recorded approval metadata is evidence only.
rules.failureCause: Automated QA was misrepresented as legal, engineering or manufacturing acceptance.
rules.prevention: Expose only evidenceContractReady from v3. Keep technicalPackageReady, productionReleaseEligible, manufacturingAuthorized and fabricationAuthorized false; never let a generator self-sign.

rules.name: evidence_file_hash_and_artifact_set_binding
rules.requirement: Production gates shall be read from real hash-fixed evidence files; machine reports shall be evaluated through rule-owned JSON Pointers; every artifact shall have a unique artifactId and exact expected-closure identity; repeated kinds shall remain granular by partId/revision/path; native source maps and recorded approval evidence shall bind the exact candidate artifact-set SHA-256; and passed=true self-reporting is forbidden.
rules.failureCause: The first production contract accepted a Boolean and arbitrary evidence string, so a caller could claim that axes, host reopen or professional review passed without supplying the report that proved it.
rules.prevention: Use the canonical domain contract and QA version; verify every portable relative path and SHA-256, require exact expected-artifact closure, apply rule-owned per-subject matrices, bind every selected source artifact by artifactId, and expose zero technical artifacts on any non-release gate mismatch.

rules.name: no_half_finished_artifact_delivery
rules.requirement: When direct production is requested, a v3 pass may expose only its evidence-contract report; it shall never expose candidate CAD/EDA artifacts or grant a technical/manufacturing/fabrication conclusion.
rules.failureCause: An incomplete floor-plan candidate was opened as if additional visual detail could make it a construction deliverable, shifting repeated correction work to the user.
rules.prevention: Use v3 solely as a portable evidence-contract verifier. Any real technical-readiness or release process must independently replay native tools, authenticate evidence and evaluate the project-specific engineering model.

rules.name: mechanical_manufacturing_definition
rules.requirement: Mechanical evidence contracts shall bind authoritative input units, operating envelope, design life and provenance; independently recomputed load paths, strength/stiffness/fatigue/FoS, joints/edges, bearing life, thermal envelope and fits; feature-bound drawing definition, native material assignment, model/drawing/inspection parity and native source hashes to one artifact set.
rules.failureCause: A geometrically complete part was mistaken for a manufacturable definition even though the shop and inspector could not determine material state, allowable variation, surface condition or acceptance method.
rules.prevention: Require every non-release canonical v3 mechanical evidence gate and mutation regression. Recorded approval fields are a separate optional evidence class; a Boolean report or attractive drawing is not independent proof and v3 never grants technical-package readiness.

rules.name: pcb_fabrication_and_assembly_definition
rules.requirement: PCB evidence contracts shall bind native schematic/project/board sources; exact symbol pin/function/electrical-type, bidirectional pad-net and reference-footprint parity; verified footprints/Pin 1/BOM-CPL; power, derating, transient, interface and protection analysis; audited ERC/DRC configuration; courtyard/edge/keepout/access placement; zero final unconnected nets; function/thermal/EMC/integrity analysis and same-revision CAM outputs.
rules.failureCause: Gerbers or an attractive routed preview were treated as proof of electrical, sourcing, thermal, EMC and assembly readiness.
rules.prevention: Require every non-release canonical v3 electronics evidence gate and mutation regression. Recorded approval fields are a separate optional evidence class; a routed preview, Gerber archive or zero headline error count is not enough and v3 never grants fabrication readiness.

rules.name: no_score_no_waiver_for_required_fabrication_gates
rules.requirement: Required manufacturing and fabrication gates are a conjunction: no score, waiver, visual approval, portable export or unrelated passing analysis may offset one failed or unavailable gate.
rules.failureCause: A mostly green dashboard concealed a missing native check or engineering analysis and presented the result as ready.
rules.prevention: Derive the result from the exact domain profile, reject missing and extra gate inventories, expose zero production artifacts on any failure, and preserve reviewOnly=true, accepted=false, ruleEnabled=false and packagingGated=true.

expectedValue.applicability: reference temperature for specification and verification
general linear and angular tolerances when invoked
limits and fits basis when invoked
limit deviations for holes and shafts when invoked
